title: Interview with former Marine lieutenant Joseph R. Owen, Company B, First Battalion, Seventh Marines, present at Chosin Reservoir Campaign.
summary: Interview with former Marine lieutenant Joseph R. Owen, Company B, First Battalion, Seventh Marines, present at Chosin Reservoir Campaign. Conducted by Jan K. Herman, Historian, Bureau of Medicine and Surgery, Washington, DC, 15 August 2000. Owen was wounded and discusses his treatment in Navy hospitals.
